Quite satisfied for a romantic date
Sep 2026 • Couples
The restaurant has a very luxurious and sophisticated space; from the arrangement, the lighting to the dining tables, everything creates a quite cozy and private feeling. I find it very suitable for dates or occasions where you want a romantic, gentle dinner.

The food is beautifully presented, and the taste is quite impressive. I tried setting Vietnam's Essence, which includes Long An duck salad, Sichuan seafood soup, Link Bistro signature fried rice, and homemade coconut ice cream. All dishes show meticulous care, and the ingredients and preparation methods convey a sense of thoroughness. My favorite dishes are the duck salad and the fried rice; the taste is just right, and it's quite addictive.

The price is at a high average, but considering the food quality, ambiance, and overall experience, I find it quite reasonable.

Pho standard ❤
Sep 2026 • Solo
I had a dining experience at Link Bistro, and this time I also tried the new Pho and Banh Mi menu. I ordered rare pho and onsen egg. Clear broth, rich with bone broth flavor, fragrant with cinnamon and star anise. Soft pho noodles steeped in hot broth but not mushy. Thinly sliced, light pink, and tender sweet beef. Herbs, my favorite thing to eat with pho is garlic vinegar, crispy garlic vinegar that is not too pungent when eating. 
Onsen eggs are delicious, the white is soft, gently wobbling with the rich and cohesive yolk.
Nguyen and Chi are wonderful, cute, and professional.
Highly recommend! 👏❤

Great location, great food, and above all, really great service.
Sep 2026 • Friends
We arrived around noon at the hotel. The lady at the front desk recommended the cafe at the lobby level for a quick lunch while waiting for the room to be ready. We ordered beef and chicken Pho, it was delicious and exceeded our expectations. The soup was very good, tasty yet mild. The lady mentioned to us afterwards that it was their first day offering Pho to guests, which was a bit of surprise considering how good the food was.
Besides the great food, one thing really stands out is the service. All the staff are very friendly, including the front desk lady and Mia, the girl works at the cafe. 
The hotel lobby is modest so you maybe wondering about what service you might expect when you first step into the hotel, but you will soon realize the great hospitality really matches the reputation. Also, the location is great, you can walk to many places and it is very close to the metro station.
I would recommend La Siesta to anyone, and would stay there again next time I travel to HCMC.

A Lovely Dining Experience
Sep 2026 • Friends
I had a lovely evening here. The space is elegant and cozy, with warm lighting, thoughtfully arranged tables, and a European bistro-inspired atmosphere. It feels quite intimate, making it a nice choice for a date or a relaxed dinner where you can sit back and enjoy a conversation.

I tried the set menu at VND 700,000 per person, which included abalone spring rolls, caviar coconut soup, Fuji rib eye pasta, and seasonal fruit. The menu offers some interesting ingredient combinations, especially the dishes that bring Vietnamese elements into a modern presentation. Everything was beautifully plated and very photogenic.

One thing I particularly appreciated was how the staff introduced each dish and explained the ingredients and combinations. At the end of the meal, there was also a complimentary drink prepared as a thank-you gesture, which was a lovely and memorable touch.

A special mention to Long, who was very friendly, attentive, and enthusiastic throughout the evening.

Overall, a lovely place to try if you’re looking for a beautiful, quiet setting and a thoughtfully curated dining experience. I was quite happy with the atmosphere, service, and the little details that made the evening feel special.
